description: What is a Likert Scale? Likert scale definition: A survey scale that quantifies audience attitudes, opinions, and perceptions. Each Likert Scale question rates the person’s level of agreement or satisfaction regarding a particular topic or series of topics. The Likert Scale responses go beyond simple ‘yes’ and ‘no’ answers, creating more valuable data. The Likert Scale design provides everything you need to acquire actionable audience insights. You can begin visualizing Likert Scale data immediately. Benefits of the Likert Scale: ● A familiar method for gathering survey data that requires little audience effort, improving response rates. ● The Likert Scale frequency adapts to the size you need (3 or 4-point Likert Scale examples ranging to 10-point scale). The 5-point Likert Scale is a popular choice; the choices range from strongly agree to strongly disagree. ● Use the Likert Scale for importance measuring, as a customer satisfaction scale, Likert agreement scale, or other types of Likert Scale options. ● Likert Scale surveys include a neutral option for people with no opinion regarding the Likert item. ● Put meaning behind numerical scores to remove subjectivity from survey responses.
